summary: S09T01 MCP resource boundary implemented as a shared @boreal/core guard with docs and regression coverage. Guard binds each request to one selected project, validates workspace/project/memory roots, and rejects paths under unselected registered projects. Focused tests, full repo tests, console build, diff check, sync refresh, and strict doctor passed.
